storage.hint: From source, data defaults to the repo's resources/; from the exe, to the exe directory. App config lives in .scikit/. Changing the data folder moves both, and it can point at an existing export project to reuse its questions.
about.intro: Capture questions from Sciyardcampus paper previews, review them question by question, then export a Word question bank.
about.tech: pywebview + Vue 3; recognition reuses Sciyardcampus_file_export algorithms.
about.data: All images, text and Word files stay in a local data folder; nothing is uploaded.
